notes.title: Hell Bug Demo Hotfix #2
notes.content:
[p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45382684/a8bf7e5604eedda4b3d7f099bff4c6317602e1da.png"][/img]We got some UX and Quality of Life updates!

-Items can be bought with "E" now, no more clicking!
-Gameplay song is changed after feedback
-An infinitie symbol added to pistol bullets, it was "111" before, we know it was confusing, sorry!
-Red text and sounds added for empty magazines and gun animations stop now after 0 bullets.[/p][p]-Automatic reloading added[/p][p]-You can control your character with arrow keys now after feedbacks

Next patch will include new guns enemies so stay tuned! Hell yeah![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Hell Bug Demo Hotfix Update 1
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45382684/ca69b97d209b25ec2e41165a5bde419caef905ba.png"][/img]We made a quick hotfix for some bugs and some balancing was needed. Here's the list:[/p][p]-No enemy spawns in rooms bug is fixed[/p][p]-Kamikaze bug not working properly bug is fixed[/p][p]-Flea health reduced from 1 to 0.5 (all guns will be able to kill them with one bullet now)[/p][p]-Shotgun bullets buffed[/p][p]-Rhino Boss health increased, dash speed increased (We heard that the boss wasn't making your life miserable enough!)[/p]
